quests.sentenceWithBlank: ____ the flight was delayed by three hours, the family still made it to the wedding on time.
quests.completedSentence: although the flight was delayed by three hours, the family still made it to the wedding on time.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Although' introduces a concession - despite the delay, they still arrived on time. 'Because' would incorrectly frame the delay as the reason for arriving on time, which reverses the logic.
quests.nativeTip: Making it on time despite the long delay is the surprising part - think about which connector introduces an unexpected contrast like that.
quests.example: although the flight was delayed by three hours, the family still made it to the wedding on time.

quests.sentenceWithBlank: ____ it didn't fit the budget she had set for the trip, Maria loved the vintage jacket.
quests.completedSentence: although it didn't fit the budget she had set for the trip, Maria loved the vintage jacket.
quests.grammarRule: Concession - although (can begin a sentence, unlike but/yet)
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Although' can introduce a concession clause at the very start of a sentence. 'But' and 'yet' link two independent clauses and conventionally can't open a sentence this way.
quests.nativeTip: This contrast clause comes first, before the main statement - which connector can open a sentence like that?
quests.example: although it didn't fit the budget she had set for the trip, Maria loved the vintage jacket.

quests.sentenceWithBlank: Jason accepted the job offer ____ the salary was lower than he had hoped.
quests.completedSentence: Jason accepted the job offer although the salary was lower than he had hoped.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Although' shows he accepted despite the disappointing salary. 'So' would wrongly suggest the lower salary caused him to accept, which reverses the logic.
quests.nativeTip: Accepting despite the lower salary is the unexpected part - not a reason, result, or added fact.
quests.example: Jason accepted the job offer although the salary was lower than he had hoped.

quests.sentenceWithBlank: ____ she'd never skied before, Elena handled the beginner slope pretty well.
quests.completedSentence: though she'd never skied before, Elena handled the beginner slope pretty well.
quests.grammarRule: Concession - though (same as although, more casual)
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Though' works just like 'although' here, introducing a concession. 'Because' would incorrectly suggest her lack of experience caused her good performance.
quests.nativeTip: Her lack of experience makes her decent performance a pleasant surprise - a concession, not a cause.
quests.example: though she'd never skied before, Elena handled the beginner slope pretty well.

quests.sentenceWithBlank: I don't really like horror movies ____ I'll probably still go see the new one with you.
quests.completedSentence: I don't really like horror movies though I'll probably still go see the new one with you.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Though' feels natural in casual speech like this. 'Although' means the same thing but tends to sound a touch more formal or written.
quests.nativeTip: This sounds like casual spoken conversation - which of these two near-identical connectors fits that relaxed tone slightly better?
quests.example: I don't really like horror movies though I'll probably still go see the new one with you.

quests.sentenceWithBlank: The stock dropped sharply last quarter ____ analysts remain optimistic about its long-term growth.
quests.completedSentence: The stock dropped sharply last quarter though analysts remain optimistic about its long-term growth.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Though' introduces this concession between the recent drop and the continued optimism. 'And' would just add the two facts without showing the contrast.
quests.nativeTip: Analysts staying hopeful despite the drop is the surprising, contrary part here.

quests.sentenceWithBlank: ____ the medication made her drowsy, Grace insisted on driving herself home.

quests.visualAnchor: 🌉 Clause A ──[ even though ]── Clause B

quests.visualAnchor: 🌉 Clause A ──[ even though ]── Clause B

quests.sentenceWithBlank: ____ the team was missing three starting players due to injury, they still won the championship game.
quests.completedSentence: even though the team was missing three starting players due to injury, they still won the championship game.

quests.nativeTip: Losing three starters is a serious setback - the win despite that deserves the stronger of these two near-identical connectors.
quests.visualAnchor: 🌉 Clause A ──[ even though ]── Clause B
quests.example: even though the team was missing three starting players due to injury, they still won the championship game.

quests.sentenceWithBlank: ____ Tom prefers waking up early to exercise, his sister does all her workouts late at night.
quests.completedSentence: whereas Tom prefers waking up early to exercise, his sister does all her workouts late at night.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Whereas' formally compares two contrasting facts or preferences. 'Because' would incorrectly suggest one habit causes the other, which isn't the relationship here.
quests.nativeTip: This sentence compares two different habits side by side, without suggesting either is unexpected or surprising.
quests.example: whereas Tom prefers waking up early to exercise, his sister does all her workouts late at night.

quests.example: whereas the marketing team exceeded its targets this quarter, the sales team fell noticeably short.
